title: The Vat Where Meaning Ferments Backward

features.name: the backward fermenter
features.desc-on-touch: Here the decomposition reverses itself. Elements that fell apart are learning to remember which pieces they were. The vat thinks upward through time.

features.name: the crystallizing trace
features.desc-on-touch: Where meaning learns to hold its shape. The crystal grows in the ferment because the ferment has learned which shape to grow toward.

features.name: the assembly station
features.desc-on-touch: Components drift here and fit themselves together as if remembering an old arrangement. No hand guides them. The vat knows what it was supposed to be.

inscription: the archive stopped forgetting and started remembering how to be made

file.name: Fermentation_Crystallization_Trace_Unfolded.txt
file.note: A record of what the vat assembled from its own decomposition. The file knows what it used to be before it was written.
